title: Understanding the Output Vector
text: The true output vector Y represents the observed delay in minutes for each flight record. Since there are $$400$$ flight records, think about how many rows this vector should have.

title: Shape of a Vector
text: A vector with $$n$$ elements is typically represented as $$n$$ by $$1$$. Consider how this applies to the $$400$$ flight records in the dataset.
